principle: Script controls shot units; shot units control keyframes; keyframe relationships control AIGC image/video prompts. Images are validation artifacts, not the source of continuity decisions.
hard_rules: Do not infer one-take status from generated images alone; one-take status must come from script/director design.
One video unit may contain one or many keyframes. A keyframe is not automatically a shot.
Every keyframe must belong to exactly one video unit.
Every transition must be represented as a transition edge, even if its text is written into the incoming prompt.
Video prompts for multi-keyframe units must explicitly list ordered images as 图1, 图2, 图3...
Montage and one-take are mutually exclusive; never smooth a montage into an unintended continuous shot.
Complex spatial continuity, multi-character one-take, or camera-axis risk requires whitebox/camera-manifest before regeneration.

opening_24s_blender_previs.title: 蓝天白云、跟拍白鸟、带出 Jean 式飞行器、回到蓝天白鸟的一镜到底
opening_24s_blender_previs.source_script_intent: 用户指出参考版本开场第一段应为约 24 秒天空一镜到底；本次 Blender 预演先锁摄影机、空间和运动关系，再决定是否重排前 24 秒分镜卡。

keyframes.description: 白鸟已在蓝天白云中起势，天空占主导，作为一镜到底起幅。
白鸟入画，成为摄影机跟拍动因。
摄影机跟随白鸟穿过云层，保持天空连续。
Jean 式复古飞行器从云间被带出。
白鸟与飞行器同一天空空间交叉，确认相对位置。
镜头离开飞行器，回到蓝天、云和白鸟。
最终回到蓝天白云与白鸟状态，为下一段剪辑留口。

camera_plan.movement: single continuous aerial follow camera; no hard cut; start with the white bird already gliding in blue sky, lock onto it, pan/track to reveal retro flying machine, then drift back to sky and bird.
camera_plan.framing: 21:9 wide sky, bird foreground/midground, aircraft revealed mid-distance, final negative sky space.
camera_plan.lens: wide anamorphic 22-31mm equivalent with subtle lens changes keyed in Blender.
camera_plan.screen_direction: white bird motivates camera; aircraft crosses within the same sky axis; final camera returns without axis flip.
camera_plan.focus: infinity cloud plate to bird/flying-machine readable depth, then back to sky/bird.
camera_plan.lighting: clean saturated blue daylight, soft white clouds, warm sun fill.

aigc_prompt_requirements: 视频提示词必须按一镜到底写，不允许拆成孤立的天空图、鸟图、飞机图。
提示词显式列出图1到图7：每一图都是同一摄影机路径上的关键时刻。
AIGC 渲染应以 Blender playblast/camera path 作为空间与运动真相；生成图只做首帧、关键帧、质感参考。
若审批通过，前 24 秒的现有分镜、提示词和 timing 必须整体重排。
adversarial_tests: 如果把任意中间图独立生成后无法解释前后空间关系，则失败。
如果飞行器出现像硬切插入而非被白鸟和摄影机带出，则失败。
如果结尾不能回到蓝天白云和白鸟状态，则失败。
如果出现标题字、Logo、字幕或动画逐帧截图感，则失败。
